title: Gakkou no Kaidan
overview:
One summer night, the seal that had imprisoned the ghosts was broken.

The released ghosts run riot in the old building of an elementary school!

Gakkou no Kaidan is a point-and-click horror adventure based on the film of the same name, using live-action footage from the movie. Explore the dark classrooms and corridors of the old school building seen through an ornate frame with watching eyes, and choose actions such as sniffing the air as you investigate the ghostly goings-on.

- 1 player
- Shuttle Mouse support
- Memory backup support

ある夏の夜、お化けを封じ込めていた封印が破られた。

解き放たれたお化けたちが、小学校の旧校舎で大騒ぎ！
